DocumentReferences.description: Comma-separated bucket file names of the claim's documents (MotorInsuranceClaim.DocumentReferences).

ExtractedCustomerName.description: Customer name found on the documents.

ExtractedPolicyNumber.description: Policy number found on the documents.

ExtractedVehicleRegistration.description: Vehicle registration found on the documents.

ExtractedIncidentDate.description: Incident date on the Claim Intimation form, YYYY-MM-DD.

ExtractedDocumentTypes.description: Comma-separated list of the document types identified.

ExtractedRepairEstimate.description: Total of the repair estimate in INR, 0 if none.

DocumentsComplete.description: True when all 7 required documents are present and readable.

MissingDocuments.description: Required documents that are missing or unreadable; empty if none.

DocumentInconsistencies.description: Material conflicts between documents; empty if none.

DocumentIngestionStatus.description: Exactly one of: Complete, Incomplete, Inconsistent.
